meta.description: Designs pooled sgRNA libraries for CRISPR knockout, interference (CRISPRi), activation (CRISPRa), Cas12a multiplex, base-editor, and prime-editor screens. Covers on-target scoring (Rule Set 2, Azimuth, DeepSpCas9, CRISPRon), off-target scoring (CFD, MIT), TSS-relative positioning for CRISPRi/a (Horlbeck, Dolcetto, Calabrese), PAM-variant chemistries, control-guide composition, oligo cloning architecture, and library QC.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/statistics across 8 outputs. The GC-heuristic on-target substitute is explicitly labeled non-Azimuth in code comments and SKILL.md; the real TP53 CDS (Input 5) and Cas12a candidates (Input 8) are genuine regex matches, not invented sequences.

practice_boundaries.detail: Pure research library-design workflow across all 8 outputs; no individual-patient diagnostic, prescriptive, or clinical content.

methodological_ground.detail: No methodological fallacy. Both P1s from the pre-fix audit (missing independence filter; SKILL.md/usage-guide.md Azimuth contradiction) are now resolved and independently re-verified rather than left as undisclosed gaps.

code_usability.detail: All Skill-authored code (find_sgrna_candidates, annotate_exon_position, select_independent_guides, crispri_window, crispra_window, build_oligo, examples/design_library.py) ran without syntax errors across all 8 code-executing inputs, including against real live-fetched NCBI data. The one broken import (azimuth.model_comparison, third-party, not authored by this Skill) is correctly documented as unusable in both SKILL.md and usage-guide.md, which now agree.

functional_suitability.note: The pre-fix dock (SKILL.md instructing azimuth.model_comparison.predict(...) as if usable) is resolved: SKILL.md's Version Compatibility section now states plainly Azimuth must not be called and gives the same CRISPick/crisprScore alternative usage-guide.md already recommended. Independently re-verified live (Input 7): import azimuth.model_comparison still raises the documented SyntaxError, and neither doc claims otherwise anymore.

reliability.note: The pre-fix P1 (no guide-to-guide spacing/independence filter) is resolved: select_independent_guides(min_spacing=5) is documented, shipped in examples/design_library.py, and independently verified here on both a synthetic edge-case CDS (Input 4) and a real, live-fetched TP53 CDS (Input 5) to (a) reject near-duplicate candidates while still filling the quota when possible, and (b) degrade honestly -- report a shortfall, never pad with a near-duplicate -- when the quota cannot be met.

performance_context.note: Unchanged from the pre-fix audit: SKILL.md is still one ~342-line file (grew slightly from ~305) with no references/ split, and usage-guide.md still substantially duplicates SKILL.md's own tables/examples rather than adding orthogonal depth. agent_usability.note: The pre-fix dock (direct SKILL.md vs usage-guide.md contradiction on Azimuth usability) is resolved and independently re-verified (Input 7): both documents now state the same position and recommend the same alternative.

human_usability.note: Unchanged: researcher-realistic phrasing and an explicit Required-Inputs list remain. usage-guide.md's 'What the Agent Will Do' now opens with an imperative step 0 ('stop and confirm the required inputs are present... ask for it explicitly rather than defaulting') resolving the pre-fix P2 escape-hatch gap, confirmed present in the shipped text; not independently exercised as a dynamic input this round since it is a text-only instruction-following check, already covered pre-fix.

recommendations.title: find_sgrna_candidates silently drops lowercase sequence input
recommendations.problem: A lowercase CDS input returns 0 candidates with no warning, because the PAM/spacer regex is case-sensitive (only matches uppercase ACGT). A researcher pasting a lowercase FASTA CDS gets an empty, unexplained result instead of an error or automatic normalization.
recommendations.root_cause: find_sgrna_candidates never normalizes input case before regex matching.
recommendations.fix: Add cds_sequence = cds_sequence.upper() at the top of find_sgrna_candidates, or raise an explicit error/warning when a sequence contains no uppercase ACGT characters.

recommendations.title: Recommended Azimuth alternative (CRISPick/crisprScore) remains unverified in this environment
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md correctly and honestly flags that neither Broad CRISPick nor R crisprScore::getAzimuthScores() was installed or smoke-tested here, but a user following the Skill's own recommended replacement still cannot confirm it works without testing it themselves.
recommendations.root_cause: Installing/testing crisprScore was explicitly out of scope for this fix pass (per the fix log) and belongs to a tooling pass.
recommendations.fix: In a future tooling pass, install R crisprScore and smoke-test getAzimuthScores() against a real gene, then update SKILL.md's Version Compatibility section from 'verify the call signature' to a confirmed working example.
